sign_convention: trajectory ordered by time_window_min DESCENDING (farthest-from-onset first); positive tau / Sen's slope == AUROC rises toward onset == clinical faithfulness
bootstrap_resample_unit: highest identifiable unit: patient (subject_id) for EPIC/VitalDB, surgical case (case_id) for MOVER/SIS
band_edges: quantiles of observed_min over ALL event cases with observed_min > 0, not over the detected subset N3 cuts on; a within-band detection rate needs every event case of that window length in its denominator
why: Table 1 and Table A1 condition on detected cases, and detection probability rises with window length, so the conditioning is a collider; this step reports the rate the tables condition on
